scope: Read-only review of the existing hosted native-import implementation; not a deployment test

findings.behavior: source_github fetches one .kicad_pcb file only; it does not fetch sibling native project dependencies.
Preserve mode retains PCB bytes, but .kicad_pro and .kicad_dru are generated from structured routing_rules. The original native .kicad_pro file is not imported.
validate_imported passes pcb, generated pro and dru to builderFabExport. It does not pass a schematic, footprint table, custom footprint library or STEP assets.
The fab export request has no dependency-file bundle field. Imported exports skip the generated projectLibraryFiles ZIP helper.
The hosted DRC summary excludes lib_footprint_issues and lib_footprint_mismatch from blocking and warning counts.

acceptance_scope: The hosted imported-board result is an independent copper/connectivity check under generated rules. Full native project acceptance uses the committed unchanged .kicad_pro, included local dependencies, raw KiCad DRC and schematic parity. The exact populated STEP is the separately hash-pinned native export.
